title: In 1814, a Wave of Beer Flooded a London Street

scenes.text: A wave of beer once flooded a London street.
In October 1814, a giant vat burst at a London brewery.
It held over three thousand barrels of porter.
More than 320,000 gallons poured out in a wave about fifteen feet high.
It tore through a crowded neighbourhood.
At least eight people died. A street, flooded with beer.

description:
In October 1814 a vat burst at a London brewery and released more than 320,000 gallons of beer.
The wave was about 15 feet high and killed at least eight people.
Would you believe it if you hadn't heard it?
